development_review: User requested a new horizontal whip with M5. Prior sideways-tip candidate kept the cable mostly vertical. This offline search limits vehicle height to 1.6 m (launch 1.4 m, target 1.25 m) to require outward cable extension; retains 15-degree +Y strike direction and 2 m/s tip speed gain. Other limits and M5 unchanged; no flight activation.
name: M5 horizontal sweep - limited climb
